destination.name: Horsham
destination.tagline: Regional Wimmera River city and gateway to the Silo Art Trail and Mount Arapiles
destination.description: Horsham is a regional city on a bend in the Wimmera River, about 300 km north-west of Melbourne, and the most populous city in the Wimmera. It is the gateway to the Silo Art Trail and the north-western side of the Grampians National Park. Mount Arapiles, about 30 minutes' drive west, rises about 140 m above the plains and is one of Australia's premier rock-climbing sites. In town, the Regional Art Gallery, the Botanic Gardens and the riverside fill a stopover on the Western Highway.
whyVisit: Rock climb on the Wimmera plains

goodToKnow.title: Bring water to Arapiles
goodToKnow.detail: Tank water at the Mount Arapiles campground is not for drinking, so bring your own and plenty of it.

goodToKnow.title: Summer heat
goodToKnow.detail: Horsham sees about 25 extreme-heat days a year and January averages a 30.6C maximum, so plan outdoor time for cooler months.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Summers are hot with frequent extreme heat, so {months} are the mild months to visit.

notes: Best months inferred from climate text. Silo art spots are not described in the research record beyond the trail itself. The Arapiles reason avoids naming the spot (general rock climbing).
